استحجبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْجَبُوا (istaḥjabū) /is.taħ.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اُسْتُحْجِبُوا (ustuḥjibū) /us.tuħ.d͡ʒi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اِسْتَحْجِبُوا (istaḥjibū) /is.taħ.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
